obligation: The institution shall ensure its rating systems provide a meaningful assessment of obligor and transaction characteristics.
quote: the institution's rating systems provide for a meaningful assessment of obligor and transaction characteristics

obligation: The institution shall ensure its rating systems provide a meaningful differentiation of risk.
quote: a meaningful differentiation of risk and accurate and consistent quantitative estimates of risk

obligation: The institution shall ensure its rating systems provide accurate and consistent quantitative estimates of risk.
quote: accurate and consistent quantitative estimates of risk

obligation: The institution shall ensure internal ratings and default and loss estimates used in own funds calculations, and the associated systems and processes, play an essential role in risk management, decision-making, credit approval, internal capital allocation and corporate governance.
quote: internal ratings and default and loss estimates used in the calculation of own funds requirements and associated systems and processes play an essential role in the risk management and decision-making process

obligation: The institution shall have a credit risk control unit responsible for its rating systems that is appropriately independent and free from undue influence.
quote: the institution has a credit risk control unit responsible for its rating systems that is appropriately independent and free from undue influence

obligation: The institution shall collect and store all relevant data to provide effective support to its credit risk measurement and management process.
quote: the institution collects and stores all relevant data to provide effective support to its credit risk measurement and management process

obligation: The institution shall document its rating systems and the rationale for their design.
quote: the institution documents its rating systems and the rationale for their design

obligation: The institution shall validate its rating systems.
quote: and validates its rating systems

obligation: The institution shall validate each rating system during an appropriate period prior to the permission to use that rating system.
quote: the institution has validated each rating system during an appropriate period prior to the permission to use that rating system

obligation: The institution shall assess, during the pre-permission validation period, whether each rating system is suited to its range of application.
quote: has assessed during that period whether each rating system is suited to the range of application of that rating system

obligation: The institution shall make the necessary changes to each rating system following from its assessment.
quote: has made the necessary changes to each rating system following from its assessment

obligation: The institution shall calculate under the IRB Approach the own funds requirements resulting from its risk parameter estimates.
quote: the institution has calculated under the IRB Approach the own funds requirements resulting from its risk parameters estimates

obligation: The institution shall be able to submit the reporting required by Article 430.
quote: is able to submit the reporting as required by Article 430

obligation: The institution shall assign, and continue to assign, each exposure in the range of application of a rating system to a rating grade or pool of that rating system.
quote: the institution has assigned and continues to assign each exposure in the range of application of a rating system to a rating grade or pool of that rating system

obligation: The institution shall apply the IRB requirements, including those for own LGD and conversion factor estimates, also to rating systems or models purchased from a third-party vendor.
quote: The requirements to use an IRB Approach, including own estimates of LGD and conversion factors, apply also where an institution has implemented a rating system, or model used within a rating system, that it has purchased from a third-party vendor.

obligation: The institution shall calculate risk-weighted exposure amounts for the specified IRB exposure classes in accordance with Sub-section 2, unless the exposures are deducted from own funds or subject to Article 72e(5) treatment.
quote: shall, unless those exposures are deducted from own funds or are subject to the treatment set out in Article 72e(5), first subparagraph, be calculated in accordance with Sub-section 2.

obligation: The institution shall calculate risk-weighted exposure amounts for dilution risk of purchased receivables in accordance with Article 157.
quote: The risk-weighted exposure amounts for dilution risk for purchased receivables shall be calculated in accordance with Article 157.

obligation: The institution shall treat purchased receivables with full recourse to the seller for both default risk and dilution risk as collateralised exposures.
quote: Where an institution has full recourse to the seller of purchased receivables for default risk and for dilution risk

obligation: The institution shall base the calculation of risk-weighted exposure amounts for credit risk and dilution risk on the relevant parameters (PD, LGD, M and exposure value) associated with the exposure.
quote: The calculation of risk-weighted exposure amounts for credit risk and dilution risk shall be based on the relevant parameters associated with the exposure in question.

obligation: The institution shall provide its own PD estimates for exposures in the exposure classes in points (a) to (d) of Article 147(2), in accordance with Article 143 and Section 6.
quote: institutions shall provide their own estimates of PDs in accordance with Article 143 and Section 6.

obligation: The institution shall provide own estimates of LGD, and IRB-CCF where applicable under Article 166(8) and (8b), for retail exposures in accordance with Article 143 and Section 6.
quote: For retail exposures, institutions shall provide own estimates of LGD, and IRB-CCF where applicable pursuant to Article 166(8) and (8b), in accordance with Article 143 and Section 6.

obligation: The institution shall use SA-CCFs for retail exposures where Article 166(8) and (8b) do not allow the use of IRB-CCF.
quote: Institutions shall use SA-CCFs where Article 166(8) and (8b) do not allow for the use of IRB-CCF.

obligation: The institution shall apply the Article 161(1) LGD values and SA-CCFs under Article 166(8), (8a) and (8b) to exposures to institutions (Art. 147(2)(b)), other financial sector entities and large corporates not in Art. 147(2)(c)(ii), rather than own estimates.
quote: institutions shall apply the LGD values set out in Article 161(1) and SA-CCFs in accordance with Article 166(8), (8a) and (8b)

obligation: The institution shall apply the Article 161(1) LGD values and SA-CCFs to the remaining exposures in Art. 147(2)(a), (aa)(i)/(ii) and (c)(i)-(iii) unless permitted to use own LGD and IRB-CCF estimates under paragraph 9.
quote: institutions shall apply the LGD values set out in Article 161(1) and the SA-CCFs in accordance with Article 166(8), (8a) and (8b), unless they have been permitted to use their own estimates of LGD and IRB-CCF

obligation: The institution shall calculate risk-weighted exposure amounts for securitised exposures and for exposures in the Art. 147(2)(f) class in accordance with Chapter 5.
quote: shall be calculated in accordance with Chapter 5.

obligation: The institution shall apply the Article 152 treatment to exposures in CIU shares or units in the Art. 147(2)(ea) class, unless deducted from own funds or subject to Article 72e(5) treatment.
quote: institutions shall apply the treatment set out in Article 152, unless those exposures are deducted from own funds

obligation: The institution shall provide own estimates of LGD subject to the requirements in Section 6 of Chapter 3 and to permission of the competent authority granted under Article 143.
quote: Institutions shall provide own estimates of LGD subject to the requirements specified in Section 6 of this Chapter and to permission of the competent authorities granted in accordance with Article 143.

obligation: The institution shall use an LGD value of 100 % for dilution risk of purchased receivables.
quote: For dilution risk of purchased receivables, an LGD value of 100 % shall be used.

obligation: The institution shall ensure that LGD values used as input to the risk-weighted exposure amount and expected loss formulae for retail exposures are not less than the Table 1 LGD input floors (retail secured by residential property 5 %; QRRE 50 % unsecured; other retail 30 % unsecured; other retail secured by financial collateral 0 %, receivables 10 %, residential or commercial immovable property 10 %, other physical collateral 15 %).
quote: the LGD values for each exposure used as an input of the risk-weighted exposure amounts and expected loss formulae shall not be less than the LGD input floor values set out in Table 1

obligation: The institution shall apply the Table 1 LGD input floors for exposures secured by funded credit protection only where the funded credit protection is eligible under Chapter 3.
quote: LGD input floors in paragraph 4, Table 1 shall be applicable for exposures secured by funded credit protection when the funded credit protection is eligible pursuant to this Chapter

obligation: The institution shall calculate the applicable LGD input floor for a retail exposure (other than secured by residential property) partially secured by funded credit protection using the formula in Article 161(6).
quote: the applicable LGD input floor for an exposure partially secured by funded credit protection is calculated in accordance with the formula set out in Article 161(6)

obligation: The institution shall apply an LGD input floor of 5 % to retail exposures secured by residential property irrespective of the level of collateral provided.
quote: for retail exposures secured by residential property, the applicable LGD input floor shall be fixed at 5 % irrespective of the level of collateral provided by the residential property.

obligation: The institution shall apply higher LGD input floor values set by the designated authority within a six-month transitional period.
quote: institutions shall have a six-month transitional period to apply them.

obligation: The institution shall apply higher minimum LGD values determined by another Member State's authority to all its corresponding exposures secured by residential or commercial immovable property located in that Member State.
quote: shall apply the higher minimum LGD values that have been determined by the authorities of another Member State in accordance with paragraph 6 to all their corresponding exposures

obligation: The institution shall measure the exposure value of on-balance sheet exposures as the accounting value, without taking into account any credit risk adjustments made.
quote: the exposure value of on-balance sheet exposures shall be the accounting value measured without taking into account any credit risk adjustments made.

obligation: The institution shall calculate the exposure value in accordance with Chapter 4 or 6 where it uses master netting agreements for repurchase transactions or securities or commodities lending or borrowing transactions.
quote: Where institutions use master netting agreements in relation to repurchase transactions or securities or commodities lending or borrowing transactions, the exposure value shall be calculated in accordance with Chapter 4 or 6.

obligation: The institution shall apply the methods set out in Chapter 4 to calculate the exposure value for on-balance sheet netting of loans and deposits.
quote: institutions shall apply the methods set out in Chapter 4.

obligation: The institution shall set the exposure value for leases at the discounted minimum lease payments.
quote: The exposure value for leases shall be the discounted minimum lease payments.

obligation: The institution shall determine the exposure value of any contract listed in Annex II by the methods set out in Chapter 6.
quote: the exposure value shall be determined by the methods set out in Chapter 6

obligation: The institution shall not take any credit risk adjustment into account when determining the exposure value of a contract listed in Annex II.
quote: shall not take into account any credit risk adjustment made.

obligation: The institution shall set the exposure value of purchased receivables for risk-weighted exposure amounts at the paragraph 1 value minus the own funds requirements for dilution risk prior to credit risk mitigation.
quote: The exposure value for the calculation of risk-weighted exposure amounts of purchased receivables shall be the value determined in accordance with paragraph 1 minus the own funds requirements for dilution risk prior to credit risk mitigation.

obligation: The institution shall set the exposure value of securities or commodities sold, posted or lent under repurchase, lending/borrowing, long settlement and margin lending transactions at the value determined in accordance with Article 24.
quote: the exposure value shall be the value of the securities or commodities determined in accordance with Article 24.

obligation: The institution shall increase the exposure value by the applicable volatility adjustment where it uses the Financial Collateral Comprehensive Method under Article 223.
quote: Where the Financial Collateral Comprehensive Method as set out under Article 223 is used, the exposure value shall be increased by the volatility adjustment appropriate to such securities or commodities

obligation: The institution shall calculate the exposure value of off-balance-sheet items that are not Annex II contracts using either IRB-CCF or SA-CCFs, in accordance with paragraphs 8a and 8b and Article 151(8).
quote: shall be calculated by using either IRB-CCF or SA-CCFs, in accordance with paragraphs 8a and 8b of this Article and Article 151(8).

obligation: The institution shall continue to hold the required own funds against the undrawn balances associated with a securitisation where only the drawn balances of revolving facilities have been securitised.
quote: institutions shall ensure that they continue to hold the required amount of own funds against the undrawn balances associated with the securitisation.

obligation: The institution without permission to use IRB-CCF shall calculate the exposure value as the committed but undrawn amount multiplied by the applicable SA-CCF.
quote: An institution that has not received permission to use IRB-CCF shall calculate the exposure value as the committed but undrawn amount multiplied by the SA-CCF concerned.

obligation: The institution that uses IRB-CCF shall calculate the exposure value for undrawn commitments as the undrawn amount multiplied by IRB-CCF.
quote: An institution that uses IRB-CCF shall calculate the exposure value for undrawn commitments as the undrawn amount multiplied by IRB-CCF.

obligation: The institution shall apply the SA-CCF to the lower of the committed but undrawn amount and the value reflecting any constraining of the facility's availability, for exposures without permission to use IRB-CCF.
quote: The amount to which the SA-CCF is to be applied shall be the lower of the value of the committed but undrawn amount and the value that reflects any possible constraining of the availability of the facility

obligation: The institution shall have sufficient line monitoring and management procedures to support the existence of a constraint where a facility is constrained.
quote: Where a facility is constrained in that way, the institution shall have sufficient line monitoring and management procedures to support the existence of that constraining.

obligation: The institution that meets the Section 6 requirements and has competent authority permission shall use IRB-CCF for exposures arising from undrawn revolving commitments under the IRB Approach, provided they would not be subject to a 100% SA-CCF under the Standardised Approach.
quote: institutions that meet the requirements for the use of IRB-CCF as specified in Section 6 shall use IRB-CCF for exposures arising from undrawn revolving commitments treated under the IRB Approach provided that those exposures would not be subject to a SA-CCF of 100 % under the Standardised Approach.

obligation: The institution shall use SA-CCFs for all other off-balance-sheet items, in particular undrawn non-revolving commitments.
quote: SA-CCFs shall be used for: (a) all other off-balance-sheet items, in particular undrawn non-revolving commitments;

obligation: The institution shall use SA-CCFs for exposures where the Section 6 minimum requirements for calculating IRB-CCF are not met or the competent authority has not permitted IRB-CCF.
quote: exposures where the minimum requirements for calculating IRB-CCF as specified in Section 6 are not met by the institution or where the competent authority has not permitted the use of IRB-CCF.

obligation: The institution shall ensure that, where IRB-CCF are used solely to calculate RWEA and EL for revolving commitments (other than Article 147(2)(a) exposures), the exposure value is not less than the CCF input floor, being the drawn amount plus 50% of the off-balance exposure amount of the undrawn part calculated using the applicable SA-CCF under Article 111.
quote: the exposure value for each exposure used as an input of the risk-weighted exposure amount and expected loss formulae shall not be less than the sum of: (a) the drawn amount of the revolving commitment; (b) 50 % of the off-balance exposure amount

obligation: The institution shall use the lower of the two conversion factors associated with the individual commitments where a commitment refers to the extension of another commitment.
quote: Where a commitment refers to the extension of another commitment, the lower of the two conversion factors associated with the individual commitment shall be used.

obligation: The institution shall use statistical or other mathematical methods ('models') to assign exposures to obligor or facility grades or pools.
quote: Institutions shall use statistical or other mathematical methods (‘models’) to assign exposures to obligor or facility grades or pools.

obligation: The model owner shall ensure the model has good predictive power.
quote: the model shall have good predictive power

obligation: The institution shall ensure that own funds requirements are not distorted as a result of the use of the model.
quote: own funds requirements shall not be distorted as a result of its use

obligation: The institution shall have in place a process for vetting data inputs into the model.
quote: the institution shall have in place a process for vetting data inputs into the model

obligation: The institution shall include in the data-vetting process an assessment of the accuracy, completeness and appropriateness of the data.
quote: which includes an assessment of the accuracy, completeness and appropriateness of the data

obligation: The model owner shall ensure the data used to build the model are representative of the population of the institution's actual obligors or exposures.
quote: the data used to build the model shall be representative of the population of the institution's actual obligors or exposures

obligation: The validation function shall run a regular cycle of model validation that includes monitoring of model performance and stability.
quote: the institution shall have a regular cycle of model validation that includes monitoring of model performance and stability

obligation: The validation function shall include review of model specification in the regular cycle of model validation.
quote: review of model specification

obligation: The validation function shall include testing of model outputs against outcomes in the regular cycle of model validation.
quote: testing of model outputs against outcomes

obligation: The institution shall complement the statistical model by human judgement and human oversight to review model-based assignments and to ensure that the models are used appropriately.
quote: the institution shall complement the statistical model by human judgement and human oversight to review model-based assignments and to ensure that the models are used appropriately.

obligation: The institution shall design review procedures to aim at finding and limiting errors associated with model weaknesses.
quote: Review procedures shall aim at finding and limiting errors associated with model weaknesses.

obligation: The institution shall ensure human judgements take into account all relevant information not considered by the model.
quote: Human judgements shall take into account all relevant information not considered by the model.

obligation: The institution shall document how human judgement and model results are to be combined.
quote: The institution shall document how human judgement and model results are to be combined.

obligation: The model owner shall ensure the model input variables form a reasonable and effective basis for the resulting predictions.
quote: the input variables shall form a reasonable and effective basis for the resulting predictions.

obligation: The model owner shall ensure the model does not have material biases.
quote: The model shall not have material biases.

obligation: The model owner shall ensure there is a functional link between the inputs and the outputs of the model, which may be determined through expert judgement where appropriate.
quote: There shall be a functional link between the inputs and the outputs of the model, which may be determined through expert judgement, where appropriate.

obligation: The institution shall consider a default to have occurred when it considers the obligor unlikely to pay its credit obligations to the institution, parent undertaking or subsidiaries in full without recourse to actions such as realising security.
quote: the institution considers that the obligor is unlikely to pay its credit obligations to the institution, the parent undertaking or any of its subsidiaries in full, without recourse by the institution to actions such as realising security

obligation: The institution shall consider a default to have occurred when the obligor is more than 90 days past due on any material credit obligation to the institution, the parent undertaking or any of its subsidiaries.
quote: the obligor is more than 90 days past due on any material credit obligation to the institution, the parent undertaking or any of its subsidiaries.

obligation: The institution shall start counting days past due for overdrafts once the obligor has breached an advised limit, been advised a limit smaller than current outstandings, or drawn credit without authorisation and the underlying amount is material.
quote: for overdrafts, days past due commence once an obligor has breached an advised limit, has been advised a limit smaller than current outstandings, or has drawn credit without authorisation and the underlying amount is material

obligation: The institution shall start counting days past due for credit cards on the minimum payment due date.
quote: days past due for credit cards commence on the minimum payment due date

obligation: The institution shall assess materiality of a past due credit obligation against the threshold defined by the competent authority.
quote: materiality of a credit obligation past due shall be assessed against a threshold, defined by the competent authorities.

obligation: The institution shall have documented policies on the counting of days past due, in particular re-ageing of facilities and the granting of extensions, amendments or deferrals, renewals, and netting of existing accounts.
quote: institutions shall have documented policies in respect of the counting of days past due, in particular in respect of the re-ageing of the facilities and the granting of extensions, amendments or deferrals, renewals, and netting of existing accounts.

obligation: The institution shall apply its days-past-due counting policies consistently over time.
quote: These policies shall be applied consistently over time

obligation: The institution shall keep its days-past-due counting policies in line with its internal risk management and decision processes.
quote: shall be in line with the internal risk management and decision processes of the institution.

obligation: The institution shall treat the listed elements (non-accrued status, specific credit adjustment from significant perceived credit quality decline, sale at material credit-related economic loss, forbearance likely to diminish the financial obligation, bankruptcy filings by the institution or obligor) as indications of unlikeliness to pay.
quote: elements to be taken as indications of unlikeliness to pay shall include the following

obligation: The institution shall make appropriate adjustments to achieve broad equivalence with the definition of default when using external data that is not itself consistent with that definition.
quote: Institutions that use external data that is not itself consistent with the definition of default laid down in paragraph 1, shall make appropriate adjustments to achieve broad equivalence with the definition of default.

obligation: The institution shall rate the obligor or facility as a non-defaulted exposure when it considers that no default trigger continues to apply to a previously defaulted exposure.
quote: the institution shall rate the obligor or facility as they would for a non-defaulted exposure.

obligation: The institution shall deem another default to have occurred where the definition of default is subsequently triggered after a return to non-defaulted status.
quote: Where the definition of default is subsequently triggered, another default would be deemed to have occurred.

obligation: The institution shall ensure its own estimates of PD, LGD, conversion factor and EL incorporate all relevant data, information and methods.
quote: an institution's own estimates of the risk parameters PD, LGD, conversion factor and EL shall incorporate all relevant data, information and methods.

obligation: The institution shall derive its risk parameter estimates using both historical experience and empirical evidence, and not purely on judgemental considerations.
quote: The estimates shall be derived using both historical experience and empirical evidence, and not based purely on judgemental considerations.

obligation: The institution shall ensure its risk parameter estimates are plausible and intuitive and based on the material drivers of the respective risk parameters.
quote: The estimates shall be plausible and intuitive and shall be based on the material drivers of the respective risk parameters.

obligation: The institution shall be more conservative in its estimation the less data it has.
quote: The less data an institution has, the more conservative it shall be in its estimation;

obligation: The institution shall be able to provide a breakdown of its loss experience in terms of default frequency, LGD, conversion factor, or loss where EL estimates are used, by the factors it sees as the drivers of the respective risk parameters.
quote: an institution shall be able to provide a breakdown of its loss experience in terms of default frequency, LGD, conversion factor, or loss where EL estimates are used, by the factors it sees as the drivers of the respective risk parameters.

obligation: The institution shall ensure its estimates are representative of long run experience.
quote: The institution's estimates shall be representative of long run experience;

obligation: The institution shall take into account any changes in lending practice or the process for pursuing recoveries over the observation periods referred to in Article 180(1)(h) and (2)(e), Article 181(1)(j) and (2), and Article 182(2) and (3).
quote: any changes in lending practice or the process for pursuing recoveries over the observation periods referred to in Article 180(1)(h) and (2)(e), Article 181(1)(j) and (2), and Article 182(2) and (3) shall be taken into account.

obligation: The institution shall ensure its estimates reflect the implications of technical advances and new data and other information as it becomes available.
quote: An institution's estimates shall reflect the implications of technical advances and new data and other information, as it becomes available.

obligation: The institution shall review its estimates when new information comes to light but at least on an annual basis.
quote: Institutions shall review their estimates when new information comes to light but at least on an annual basis;

obligation: The institution shall ensure the population of exposures in the estimation data, the lending standards used when the data was generated and other relevant characteristics are comparable with those of its exposures and standards.
quote: the population of exposures represented in the data used for estimation, the lending standards used when the data was generated and other relevant characteristics shall be comparable with those of the institution's exposures and standards.

obligation: The institution shall ensure the economic or market conditions underlying the estimation data are relevant to current and foreseeable conditions.
quote: The economic or market conditions that underlie the data shall be relevant to current and foreseeable conditions.

obligation: The institution shall ensure the number of exposures in the sample and the data period used for quantification are sufficient to give confidence in the accuracy and robustness of its estimates.
quote: The number of exposures in the sample and the data period used for quantification shall be sufficient to provide the institution with confidence in the accuracy and robustness of its estimates;

obligation: The institution shall ensure estimates for purchased receivables reflect all relevant information available to it regarding the quality of the underlying receivables, including data for similar pools from the seller, itself or external sources.
quote: for purchased receivables the estimates shall reflect all relevant information available to the purchasing institution regarding the quality of the underlying receivables

obligation: The institution shall evaluate any data relied upon that is provided by the seller of purchased receivables.
quote: The purchasing institution shall evaluate any data relied upon which is provided by the seller;

obligation: The institution shall include appropriate adjustments in its estimates, to the extent possible, to overcome biases.
quote: to overcome biases, an institution shall include appropriate adjustments in its estimates to the extent possible;

obligation: The institution shall, after including appropriate adjustments, add to its estimates a sufficient margin of conservatism related to the expected range of estimation errors.
quote: after having included an appropriate adjustment, it shall add to its estimates a sufficient margin of conservatism that is related to the expected range of estimation errors;

obligation: The institution shall apply a larger margin of conservatism where methods and data are considered less satisfactory and the expected range of errors is larger.
quote: where methods and data are considered to be less satisfactory, the expected range of errors is larger, and the margin of conservatism shall be larger.

obligation: The institution using pooled data shall ensure the rating systems and criteria of other institutions in the pool are similar to its own.
quote: the rating systems and criteria of other institutions in the pool are similar to its own

obligation: The institution using pooled data shall ensure the pool is representative of the portfolio for which the pooled data is used.
quote: the pool is representative of the portfolio for which the pooled data is used

obligation: The institution using pooled data shall use the pooled data consistently over time for its estimates.
quote: the pooled data is used consistently over time by the institution for its estimates

obligation: The institution using pooled data shall remain responsible for the integrity of its rating systems.
quote: the institution shall remain responsible for the integrity of its rating systems

obligation: The institution using pooled data shall maintain sufficient in-house understanding of its rating systems, including the ability to effectively monitor and audit the rating process.
quote: the institution shall maintain sufficient in-house understanding of its rating systems, including the ability to effectively monitor and audit the rating process.

obligation: The institution shall document, and ensure are reasonable, any differences between estimates used for calculating risk weights and those used for internal purposes.
quote: Where institutions use different estimates for the calculation of risk weights and for internal purposes, it shall be documented and be reasonable.

obligation: The institution shall estimate PDs by obligor grade from long run averages of one-year default rates for central government, central bank, regional government, local authority, public sector entity, institution and corporate exposures.
quote: institutions shall estimate PDs by obligor grade from long run averages of one-year default rates.

obligation: The institution shall ensure PD estimates for highly leveraged obligors or obligors whose assets are predominantly traded assets reflect the performance of the underlying assets based on periods of stressed volatilities.
quote: PD estimates for obligors that are highly leveraged or for obligors whose assets are predominantly traded assets shall reflect the performance of the underlying assets based on periods of stressed volatilities;

obligation: The institution deriving long run average PD and LGD estimates for purchased corporate receivables from an EL estimate shall ensure the process for estimating total losses meets the overall standards for estimation of PD and LGD.
quote: the process for estimating total losses shall meet the overall standards for estimation of PD and LGD set out in this part

obligation: The institution deriving long run average PD and LGD estimates for purchased corporate receivables from an EL estimate shall ensure the outcome is consistent with the concept of LGD in Article 181(1)(a).
quote: the outcome shall be consistent with the concept of LGD as set out in Article 181(1)(a);

obligation: The institution shall use PD estimation techniques only with supporting analysis.
quote: institutions shall use PD estimation techniques only with supporting analysis.

obligation: The institution shall recognise the importance of judgmental considerations in combining results of techniques and in making adjustments for limitations of techniques and information.
quote: Institutions shall recognise the importance of judgmental considerations in combining results of techniques and in making adjustments for limitations of techniques and information;

obligation: The model owner shall ensure that PD estimates based on internal default experience reflect current underwriting standards and any differences between the rating system that generated the data and the current rating system.
quote: the estimates shall be reflective of current underwriting standards and of any differences in the rating system that generated the data and the current rating system

obligation: The institution shall add a greater margin of conservatism to its PD estimate, for the expected range of estimation errors not already covered by the appropriate adjustment, where underwriting standards or rating systems have changed.
quote: where underwriting standards or rating systems have changed, after including an appropriate adjustment, the institution shall add a greater margin of conservatism in its estimate of PD

obligation: The institution shall base any mapping of internal grades to an ECAI scale on a comparison of internal rating criteria to the external organisation's criteria and on a comparison of internal and external ratings of any common obligors.
quote: mappings shall be based on a comparison of internal rating criteria to the criteria used by the external organisation and on a comparison of the internal and external ratings of any common obligors

obligation: The institution shall avoid biases or inconsistencies in the mapping approach or underlying data when mapping internal grades to an external scale.
quote: Biases or inconsistencies in the mapping approach or underlying data shall be avoided.

obligation: The institution shall ensure that the external organisation's criteria underlying the data used for quantification are oriented to default risk only and do not reflect transaction characteristics.
quote: The criteria of the external organisation underlying the data used for quantification shall be oriented to default risk only and not reflect transaction characteristics.

obligation: The institution shall include in its mapping analysis a comparison of the default definitions used, subject to the requirements in Article 178.
quote: The analysis undertaken by the institution shall include a comparison of the default definitions used, subject to the requirements in Article 178.

obligation: The institution shall document the basis for the mapping of internal grades to the external scale.
quote: The institution shall document the basis for the mapping;

obligation: The institution shall ensure that its use of default probability models to estimate PDs as the simple average of obligor-level estimates in a grade meets the standards specified in Article 174.
quote: The institution's use of default probability models for this purpose shall meet the standards specified in Article 174;

obligation: The institution shall use a historical observation period of at least five years for at least one source for PD estimation, whether external, internal or pooled data are used.
quote: the length of the underlying historical observation period used shall be at least five years for at least one source

obligation: The institution shall estimate a PD for each rating grade based on the observed historical average one-year default rate, calculated as an arithmetic average based on the number of obligors (count weighted).
quote: institutions shall estimate a PD for each rating grade based on the observed historical average one-year default rate that is an arithmetic average based on the number of obligors (count weighted)

obligation: The institution shall not use other averaging approaches, including exposure-weighted averages, to estimate PD per grade.
quote: other approaches, including exposure-weighted averages, shall not be permitted.

obligation: The institution shall estimate retail PDs by obligor or facility grade or pool from long run averages of one-year default rates, calculated at facility level only where the definition of default is applied at individual credit facility level.
quote: institutions shall estimate PDs by obligor or facility grade or pool from long run averages of one-year default rates, and default rates shall be calculated at facility level only where the definition of default is applied at individual credit facility level

obligation: The institution shall base retail PD on the observed historical average one-year default rate.
quote: the PD shall be based on the observed historical average one-year default rate.

obligation: The institution shall regard internal data for assigning exposures to grades or pools as the primary source of information for estimating retail loss characteristics.
quote: institutions shall regard internal data for assigning exposures to grades or pools as the primary source of information for estimating loss characteristics

obligation: The institution shall use external data or statistical models for retail quantification only where strong links exist between its grade assignment process and the external source's process, and between its internal risk profile and the composition of the external data.
quote: Institutions may use external data (including pooled data) or statistical models for quantification provided that the following strong links both exist

key: EBA GL definition of default (GL/2016/07) para. 107

key: EBA GL definition of default (GL/2016/07) para. 108

quote: Control mechanisms should ensure that the relevant information is used in the default identification process immediately after being obtained.

key: EBA GL definition of default (GL/2016/07) para. 108

obligation: The institution should ensure that delays in recording default do not lead to errors or inconsistencies in risk management, risk reporting, own funds requirements calculation or the use of data in risk quantification.
quote: such delays should not lead to errors or inconsistencies in risk management, risk reporting, the own funds requirements calculation or the use of data in risk quantification.

key: EBA GL definition of default (GL/2016/07) para. 108
obligation: The institution should ensure that internal and external reporting figures reflect a situation where all exposures are correctly classified.
quote: it should be ensured that the internal and external reporting figures reflect a situation where all exposures are correctly classified.

obligation: The institution should document its policies on the definition of default, including all triggers for identification of default, the exit criteria and a clear identification of the scope of application.
quote: Institutions should document their policies regarding the definition of default including all triggers for identification of default and the exit criteria as well as clear identification of the scope of application

key: EBA GL definition of default (GL/2016/07) para. 109
obligation: The institution should document the operationalisation of all indications of default.
quote: (a) document the operationalisation of all indications of default;

key: EBA GL definition of default (GL/2016/07) para. 109
obligation: The institution should document the operationalisation of the criteria for reclassification of a defaulted obligor to a non-defaulted status.
quote: (b) document the operationalisation of the criteria for reclassification of a defaulted obligor to a non-defaulted status;

key: EBA GL definition of default (GL/2016/07) para. 109
obligation: The institution should keep an updated register of all definitions of default.
quote: (c) keep an updated register of all definitions of default.

key: EBA GL definition of default (GL/2016/07) para. 110
obligation: The institution should document the application of the definition of default in detail, including the process, sources of information and responsibilities for identifying each indication of default.
quote: institutions should document the application of the definition of default in a detailed manner by including the operationalization of all indications of default, including the process, sources of information and responsibilities

key: EBA GL definition of default (GL/2016/07) para. 111
obligation: The institution should document the criteria for reclassification of a defaulted obligor to non-defaulted status, including processes, sources of information and responsibilities assigned to relevant personnel.
quote: institutions should document the operationalization of the criteria for reclassification of a defaulted obligor to a non-defaulted status, including the processes, sources of information and responsibilities assigned to relevant personnel.

key: EBA GL definition of default (GL/2016/07) para. 112
obligation: The institution should include in its default documentation a description of all automatic mechanisms and manual processes.
quote: the documentation should include description of all automatic mechanisms and manual processes

key: EBA GL definition of default (GL/2016/07) para. 112
obligation: The institution should describe manually applied qualitative indications of default or return-to-non-default criteria in sufficient detail to facilitate common understanding and consistent application by all responsible personnel.
quote: the description should be sufficiently detailed to facilitate common understanding and consistent application by all responsible personnel.

key: EBA GL definition of default (GL/2016/07) para. 113
obligation: The institution should keep an updated register of all current and past versions of the default definition, at least starting from the date of application of the guidelines.
quote: institutions should keep an updated register of all current and past versions of the default definition at least starting from the date of application of these guidelines.

key: EBA GL definition of default (GL/2016/07) para. 113
obligation: The institution should record in the default definition register the scope of application, the approving body and approval date, implementation date, a brief description of changes versus the last version, and for IRB institutions the change category, date of submission to competent authorities and approval date.
quote: This register should include at least the following information:

key: EBA GL definition of default (GL/2016/07) para. 114
obligation: The institution using the IRB Approach should adopt adequate mechanisms and procedures to ensure the definition of default is implemented and used correctly.
quote: Institutions that use the IRB Approach should adopt adequate mechanisms and procedures in order to ensure that the definition of default is implemented and used in a correct manner

key: EBA GL definition of default (GL/2016/07) para. 114
obligation: The management body, or a committee designated by it, and senior management shall approve the definition of default and the scope of its application in accordance with Article 189(1) of Regulation (EU) 575/2013.
quote: the definition of default and the scope of its application is what is required to be approved by the management body, or by a committee designated by it, and by senior management in accordance with Article 189(1)

key: EBA GL definition of default (GL/2016/07) para. 114
obligation: The institution should use the definition of default consistently for own funds requirements calculation and in internal risk management, at least in monitoring of exposures and internal reporting to senior management and the management body.
quote: the definition of default is used consistently for the purpose of the own funds requirements calculation and plays a meaningful role in the internal risk management processes

key: EBA GL definition of default (GL/2016/07) para. 114
obligation: The internal audit unit or another comparable independent auditing unit should regularly review the robustness and effectiveness of the default identification process, taking into account timeliness of identification of default.
quote: the internal audit unit or another comparable independent auditing unit reviews regularly the robustness and effectiveness of the process used by the institution for the identification of default

key: EBA GL definition of default (GL/2016/07) para. 114
obligation: The internal audit unit should communicate its review conclusions and recommendations, and the measures taken to remedy identified weaknesses, directly to the management body or its designated committee.
quote: ensuring that the conclusions of the internal audit's review and respective recommendations, as well as the measures taken to remedy the identified weaknesses are communicated directly to the management body or the committee designated by it.

obligation: The institution shall treat exposures covered by the same rating system similarly in terms of risk management, decision making and credit approval process.
quote: Exposures covered by the same rating system should be treated similarly by the institution in terms of risk management, decision making and credit approval process

obligation: The institution shall assign exposures covered by the same rating system to a common obligor rating scale and a common facility rating scale.
quote: should be assigned to a common obligor rating scale for the purposes of Article 170(1)(b) of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 and a common facility rating scale

obligation: The institution shall apply the same definition of default for the same historical observations used in different models within a rating system when quantifying risk parameters.
quote: institutions should apply the same definition of default for the same historical observations used in different models

obligation: The institution shall apply the same treatment of multiple defaults of the same obligor or exposure across internal, external and pooled data sources.
quote: Institutions should also apply the same treatment of multiple defaults of the same obligor or exposure across internal, external and pooled data sources.

obligation: The institution shall ensure that its data quality policies apply to all data used in model development and calibration.
quote: institutions should ensure that those policies apply to all data used in model development and calibration

obligation: The institution shall ensure that its data quality policies apply to the data used in the application of the risk parameters.
quote: as well as to the data used in the application of the risk parameters

obligation: The institution shall ensure that data used in model development and as model inputs is sufficiently precise to avoid material distortions of the outcome of the assignment of exposures to grades or pools.
quote: it should be sufficiently precise to avoid material distortions of the outcome of the assignment of exposures to obligors or facility grades or pools

obligation: The institution shall ensure that data used in model development and application does not contain biases that make the data unfit for purpose.
quote: it should not contain any biases which make the data unfit for purpose

obligation: The institution shall have sound policies, processes and methods for assessing the representativeness of data used for the estimation of risk parameters.
quote: institutions should have sound policies, processes and methods for assessing the representativeness of data used for the purpose of estimation of risk parameters

obligation: The institution shall specify in its internal policies the statistical tests and metrics used to assess representativeness of data used for risk differentiation and, separately, of data underlying risk quantification.
quote: Institutions should specify in their internal policies the statistical tests and metrics to be used for the purpose of assessing the representativeness of data used for risk differentiation and, separately, for data underlying the risk quantification.

obligation: The institution shall specify methods for qualitative assessment of data representativeness for cases defined in its policies where statistical tests cannot be applied.
quote: Institutions should also specify methods for qualitative assessment of data for the cases, defined in their policies, where the application of statistical tests is not possible.

obligation: The institution shall use the same standards and methods to assess representativeness of data from different sources (internal, external, pooled), unless different methods are justified by the specificity of the data source or availability of information.
quote: Institutions should use the same standards and methods for the assessment of representativeness of data stemming from different sources

obligation: The institution shall obtain sufficient information from data providers to assess the representativeness of external or pooled data to its own portfolios and processes.
quote: institutions should obtain sufficient information from the data providers to assess the representativeness of such external or pooled data to the institutions' own portfolios and processes

obligation: The institution shall analyse the representativeness of data for statistical models and other mechanical methods used to assign exposures to grades or pools, and for statistical default prediction models.
quote: Institutions should analyse the representativeness of data in the case of statistical models and other mechanical methods used to assign exposures to grades or pools

obligation: The institution shall select an appropriate model development dataset so that model performance on the application portfolio, in particular discriminatory power, is not significantly hindered by insufficient data representativeness.
quote: Institutions should select an appropriate dataset for the purpose of model development to ensure that the performance of the model on the application portfolio, in particular its discriminatory power, is not significantly hindered

obligation: The institution shall analyse, at the model development stage, the representativeness of the data in terms of scope of application, definition of default, distribution of relevant risk characteristics, and lending standards and recovery policies.
quote: institutions should analyse the representativeness of the data at the stage of model development in terms of all of the following:

obligation: The institution shall analyse the segmentation of exposures and consider whether the scope of application of the model changed over the period covered by the development data.
quote: institutions should analyse the segmentation of exposures and consider whether there were any changes to the scope of application of the considered model

obligation: The institution shall, where the model scope changed, analyse the relevant risk drivers by comparing their distribution in the RDS before and after the change and with the application portfolio.
quote: Where such changes were observed institutions should analyse the risk drivers relevant for the change of the scope of application of the model by comparing their distribution in the RDS before and after the change

obligation: The institution shall apply statistical methodologies such as cluster analysis or similar techniques to demonstrate representativeness when the model scope changed.
quote: institutions should apply statistical methodologies such as cluster analysis or similar techniques to demonstrate representativeness

obligation: The institution shall, for pooled models, perform the scope representativeness analysis with regard to the part of the model scope that it uses.
quote: In the case of pooled models the analysis should be performed with regard to the part of the scope of the model that is used by an institution.

obligation: The institution shall ensure that the definition of default underlying model development data is consistent over time.
quote: institutions should ensure that the definition of default underlying the data used for model development is consistent over time

obligation: The institution shall make adjustments to achieve consistency with the current default definition where the default definition changed during the observation period.
quote: adjustments have been made to achieve consistency with the current default definition where the default definition has been changed during the observation period

obligation: The institution shall adopt adequate measures where the model covers exposures in several jurisdictions having or having had different default definitions.
quote: adequate measures have been adopted by the institution, where the model covers exposures in several jurisdictions having or having had different default definitions

obligation: The institution shall analyse the definition of default in each data source separately.
quote: the definition of default in each data source has been analysed separately

obligation: The institution shall ensure that a model-development default definition differing from the Article 178 definition does not negatively impact the rating model's risk differentiation and predictive power.
quote: the definition of default used for the purposes of model development does not have a negative impact on the structure and performance of the rating model, in terms of risk differentiation and predictive power

obligation: The institution shall analyse the distribution and range of values of key risk characteristics of the development data used for risk differentiation in comparison with the application portfolio.
quote: institutions should analyse the distribution and range of values of key risk characteristics of the data used in developing the model for risk differentiation in comparison with the application portfolio

obligation: The institution shall perform the key risk characteristics analysis for LGD models separately for non-defaulted and defaulted exposures.
quote: With regard to LGD models, institutions should perform such analysis separately for non-defaulted and defaulted exposures.

obligation: The institution should analyse the representativeness of the data in terms of portfolio structure by relevant risk characteristics, using statistical tests specified in its policies, to ensure the range of values observed in the application portfolio is adequately reflected in the development sample.
quote: Institutions should analyse the representativeness of the data in terms of the structure of the portfolio by relevant risk characteristics based on statistical tests specified in their policies

obligation: Where statistical tests cannot be applied, the institution should carry out at least a qualitative analysis based on descriptive statistics of the portfolio structure, taking into account possible seasoning effects under Article 180(2)(f) CRR.
quote: Where the application of statistical tests is not possible, institutions should carry out at least a qualitative analysis on the basis of the descriptive statistics of the structure of the portfolio

obligation: The institution should take into account the sensitivity of the risk characteristics to economic conditions when considering the results of the representativeness analysis.
quote: institutions should take into account the sensitivity of the risk characteristics to economic conditions

obligation: The institution should address material differences in key risk characteristics between the data sample and the application portfolio, for example by using another data sample or a subset of observations or by reflecting these characteristics as risk drivers in the model.
quote:
Material differences in the key risk characteristics between the data sample and the application portfolio should be
addressed

obligation: The institution should analyse whether, over the relevant historical observation period, there were significant changes in lending standards, recovery policies or the legal environment that may influence the level of risk or the distribution of risk characteristics in the portfolio covered by the model.
quote: institutions should analyse whether, over the relevant historical observation period, there were significant changes in their lending standards or recovery policies or in the relevant legal environment

obligation: Where the institution observes such changes in lending standards, recovery policies or legal environment, it should compare the data included in the RDS before and after the change of policy.
quote: Where institutions observe such changes they should compare the data included in the RDS before and after the change of the policy.

obligation: The institution should ensure comparability of current underwriting or recovery standards with those applied to the observations included in the RDS and used for model development.
quote: Institutions should ensure comparability of the current underwriting or recovery standards with those applied to the observations included in the RDS and used for model development.

obligation: The institution should have a sufficient number of defaulted and non-defaulted observations in the PD model development dataset.
quote: institutions should have a sufficient number of defaulted and non-defaulted observations in the development dataset

obligation: The institution should document the difference between the proportion of defaulted and non-defaulted exposures in the development dataset and in the application portfolio.
quote: they should document the difference

obligation: The institution should analyse the comparability of data used to calculate long-run average default rates or long-run average LGDs, and where relevant the representativeness of the pool, in terms of scope of application, definition of default, distribution of risk characteristics, current and foreseeable economic or market conditions, and lending standards and recovery policies.
quote: institutions should analyse the comparability of the data used for the purpose of calculating long-run average default rates or long-run average LGDs as referred to in Article 179(1)(d)

obligation: The institution should analyse the scope of application of the calibration data as specified in paragraph 22.
quote: For the purpose of paragraph 28(a) institutions should perform an analysis as specified in paragraph 22.

obligation: The institution should compare the definition of default it currently applies with the definitions used for the observations in the dataset used for risk quantification, to ensure consistency with Article 178 CRR.
quote:
institutions should compare the
definition of default applied by the institution currently with the definitions used for the observations included in the dataset used for risk quantification

obligation: Where the definition of default changed during the historical observation period, the institution should assess the representativeness of historical data in the RDS used for risk quantification in the same way as for external data under Chapter 6 of the EBA Guidelines on the definition of default.
quote: Where the definition of default has changed during the historical observation period institutions should assess the representativeness of historical data included in the RDS and used for risk quantification

obligation: Where the definition of default changed more than once during the historical observation period, the institution should analyse each past definition of default separately.
quote: institutions should perform the analysis of each of the past definitions of default separately

obligation: The institution should perform an appropriate analysis to ensure that, at calibration segment level, the ranges of values of key risk characteristics in the application portfolio are comparable to those in the reference data set to the degree required to ensure unbiased risk quantification.
quote: institutions should perform an appropriate analysis to ensure that at the level of the calibration segment the ranges of values of the key risk characteristics in the application portfolio are comparable

obligation: The institution should analyse the market and economic conditions underlying the data for PD estimation in accordance with section 5.3.4.
quote: with regard to the PD estimation, in accordance with section 5.3.4;

obligation: The institution should analyse the market and economic conditions underlying the data for LGD estimation in accordance with section 6.3.2, taking into account the economic downturn required by Article 181(1)(b) CRR.
quote: with regard to the LGD estimation, in accordance with section 6.3.2 and taking into account the consideration of economic downturn as required by Article 181(1)(b)

obligation: The institution should analyse whether there were significant changes in lending standards or recovery policies over the historical observation period that may influence the level of risk or the distribution of risk driver characteristics in the portfolio covered by the model.
quote: institutions should analyse whether there were significant changes in the lending standards or recovery policies over the relevant historical observation period

obligation: Where significant changes in lending standards or recovery policies are observed, the institution should analyse the potential bias in PD estimates in terms of the level of default rates and the likely range of variability of default rates.
quote: with regard to the PD estimation, in terms of the level of default rates and the likely range of variability of default rates;

obligation: Where significant changes in lending standards or recovery policies are observed, the institution should analyse the potential bias in LGD estimates in terms of loss rates, average duration of recovery processes, frequencies of use of certain recovery scenarios and loss severity distributions.
quote: with regard to the LGD estimation, in terms of loss rates, average duration of the recovery processes, frequencies of use of certain recovery scenarios and the loss severity distributions.

obligation: Where data representativeness is insufficient and leads to bias or increased uncertainty in risk quantification, the institution should introduce an appropriate adjustment to correct the bias.
quote: institutions should introduce an appropriate adjustment to correct the bias

obligation: Where data representativeness is insufficient and leads to bias or increased uncertainty in risk quantification, the institution should apply a margin of conservatism in accordance with section 4.4.
quote: they should apply a margin of conservatism in accordance with section 4.4

obligation: When complementing statistical models with human judgement, the institution should assess the modelling assumptions and whether the selected risk drivers contribute to the risk assessment in line with their economic meaning.
quote: assess the modelling assumptions and whether the selected risk drivers contribute to the risk assessment in line with their economic meaning

obligation: When complementing statistical models with human judgement, the institution should analyse the impact of the human judgement on model performance.
quote: analyse the impact of the human judgement on the performance of the model

obligation: The institution should ensure that any form of human judgement is properly justified.
quote: ensure that any form of human judgement is properly justified

obligation: The institution should document the application of human judgement in the model, including at least the criteria for the assessment, rationale, assumptions, experts involved and description of the process.
quote: document the application of human judgement in the model, including at least the criteria for the assessment, rationale, assumptions, experts involved and description of the process

obligation: The institution should identify all deficiencies in the estimation of risk parameters that lead to a bias in quantification or to increased uncertainty not fully captured by the general estimation error.
quote: Institutions should identify all deficiencies related to the estimation of risk parameters that lead to a bias in the quantification of those parameters or to an increased uncertainty that is not fully captured by the general estimation error

obligation: The institution should classify each identified estimation deficiency as Category A (data and methodological deficiencies) or Category B (changes to underwriting standards, risk appetite, collection and recovery policies and other sources of additional uncertainty).
quote: classify each deficiency into one of the following categories:

obligation: The institution should take into account all relevant deficiencies in methods, processes, controls, data or IT systems identified by the credit risk control unit, validation function, internal audit function or any other internal or external review when identifying and classifying deficiencies.
quote: institutions should take into account all relevant deficiencies in methods, processes, controls, data or IT systems that have been identified by the credit risk control unit, validation function, internal audit function or any other internal or external review

obligation: The institution should analyse at least all the listed potential sources of additional uncertainty in risk quantification under Category A (e.g. default triggers, date of default, rating assignment, risk driver data, recoveries data, economic loss data, external data representativeness, averaging approach for default rates, downturn information) and Category B (changes to underwriting, collection or recovery policies, portfolio deviations, market or legal changes, forward-looking portfolio changes).
quote: should analyse at least all of the following potential sources of additional uncertainty in risk quantification

obligation: The institution should apply adequate methodologies to correct identified deficiencies to the extent possible, in order to overcome biases in risk parameter estimates.
quote: institutions should apply adequate methodologies to correct the identified deficiencies to the extent possible

obligation: The institution should ensure that applying an appropriate adjustment results in a best estimate of the risk parameter.
quote: Institutions should ensure and provide evidence that the application of an appropriate adjustment results in a best estimate.

obligation: The institution should provide evidence that applying an appropriate adjustment results in a best estimate.
quote: Institutions should ensure and provide evidence that the application of an appropriate adjustment results in a best estimate.

obligation: The institution should document the methods used to apply appropriate adjustments to rectify identified deficiencies, where relevant, and their justification.
quote: Institutions should document the methods used to apply appropriate adjustments to rectify the identified deficiencies, where relevant, as well as their justification.

obligation: The institution should regularly monitor the adequacy of appropriate adjustments.
quote: Institutions should regularly monitor the adequacy of appropriate adjustments.

obligation: The institution should not rely on an appropriate adjustment as a replacement for addressing the identified deficiencies.
quote: The adoption of an appropriate adjustment by institutions should not replace the need to address the identified deficiencies.

obligation: The institution should implement a framework for quantification, documentation and monitoring of estimation errors to support the margin of conservatism related to the expected range of estimation errors.
quote: institutions should implement a framework for quantification, documentation and monitoring of estimation errors

obligation: The institution should ensure the final MoC reflects the estimation uncertainty in Category A (data and methodological deficiencies), Category B (changes to underwriting, risk appetite, collection and recovery policies and other additional uncertainty) and Category C (general estimation error).
quote: The final MoC on a risk parameter estimate should reflect the uncertainty of the estimation in all of the following categories:

obligation: The institution should quantify MoC for identified deficiencies, to the extent not covered by the general estimation error, at least for each of categories A and B at the level of the calibration segment.
quote: quantify MoC for the identified deficiencies referred to in paragraphs 36 and 37, to the extent not covered by the general estimation error, at least for each of the categories A and B at the level of the calibration segment

obligation: The institution should ensure that, where appropriate adjustments are used, the MoC accounts for any increase in uncertainty or additional estimation error associated with these adjustments.
quote: where appropriate adjustments in the sense of paragraph 38 are used, the MoC accounts for any increase in the uncertainty or additional estimation error associated with these adjustments

obligation: The institution should ensure that the MoC at category level related to appropriate adjustments is proportionate to the uncertainty around these adjustments.
quote: the MoC at category level related to the appropriate adjustments is proportionate to the uncertainty around these adjustments

obligation: The institution should apply MoC to address the uncertainty stemming from deficiencies that have not been corrected via appropriate adjustments.
quote: the MoC is applied to address the uncertainty of the risk parameter estimate stemming from any deficiencies among those referred to in paragraphs 36 and 37 that have not been corrected via appropriate adjustments

obligation: The institution should quantify the general estimation error (category C) associated with the underlying estimation method at least for every calibration segment, with the MoC reflecting the dispersion of the distribution of the statistical estimator.
quote: quantify the general estimation error of category C referred to in paragraph 42 associated with the underlying estimation method at least for every calibration segment; the MoC for the general estimation error should reflect the dispersion

obligation: The institution should quantify the final MoC as the sum of the category A MoC, the category B MoC and the MoC for the general estimation error (category C).
quote: Institutions should quantify the final MoC as the sum of:

obligation: The institution should add the final MoC to the best estimate of the risk parameter.
quote: Institutions should add the final MoC to the best estimate of the risk parameter.

obligation: The institution should ensure that the impact of the final MoC does not result in lowering the risk parameter estimates.
quote: Institutions should ensure that the impact of the final MoC does not result in lowering the risk parameter estimates

obligation: The institution should ensure that the MoC stemming from the general estimation error is greater than zero.
quote: the MoC stemming from the general estimation error is greater than zero

obligation: The institution should ensure that the MoC for each of categories A and B is proportionate to the increased uncertainty caused by the identified deficiencies in that category and is greater than or equal to zero.
quote: the MoC stemming from each of the categories A and B is proportionate to the increased uncertainty in the best estimate of risk parameters caused by the identified deficiencies listed in each category.

obligation: The institution shall consider the overall impact of identified deficiencies and the resulting final MoC on the soundness of the model.
quote: Institutions should consider the overall impact of the identified deficiencies and the resulting final MoC on the soundness of the model

obligation: The institution shall ensure that risk parameter estimates and the resulting own funds requirements are not distorted by the necessity for excessive adjustments.
quote: ensure that the estimates of the risk parameters and the resulting own funds requirements are not distorted by the necessity for excessive adjustments

obligation: The institution shall document the MoC applied for each rating system in the relevant model documentation and methodology manuals.
quote: For each rating system, the MoC applied should be documented in the relevant model documentation and methodology manuals.

obligation: The institution shall include in the MoC documentation a complete list of all identified deficiencies, including errors and uncertainties, and the potentially affected model components or risk parameters.
quote: a complete list of all identified deficiencies, including errors and uncertainties, and the potentially affected model components or risk parameters

obligation: The institution shall include in the MoC documentation the category under which each identified deficiency is classified, as referred to in paragraph 42.
quote: the category under which these deficiencies are classified, as referred to in paragraph 42

obligation: The institution shall include in the MoC documentation a description of the methods for quantifying the MoC for identified deficiencies, in particular the methodologies used per category.
quote: a description of the methods for quantification of the MoC related to identified deficiencies as referred to in paragraph 43(a) and in particular the methodologies used to quantify the MoC per category

obligation: The institution shall regularly monitor the levels of the MoC.
quote: Institutions should regularly monitor the levels of the MoC.

obligation: The institution shall not use a MoC as a replacement for addressing the causes of errors or uncertainties or for correcting models to ensure full compliance with Regulation (EU) No 575/2013.
quote: The adoption of a MoC by institutions should not replace the need to address the causes of errors or uncertainties, or to correct the models to ensure their full compliance with the requirements of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013.

obligation: The institution shall develop a plan to rectify data and methodological deficiencies and other sources of additional uncertainty and reduce estimation errors within a reasonable timeframe, considering the materiality of the estimation error and of the rating system.
quote: institutions should develop a plan to rectify the data and methodological deficiencies as well as any other potential source of additional uncertainty and reduce the estimation errors within a reasonable timeframe

obligation: The institution shall include the MoC from categories A and B in internal reporting separately for each category, and may reduce it over time and eventually eliminate it once deficiencies are rectified in all affected parts of the rating system.
quote: the MoC stemming from categories A and B referred to in paragraphs 36 and 37 is included in internal reporting separately for each category and may be reduced over time and eventually eliminated

obligation: The institution shall include the MoC stemming from general estimation error in internal reporting in a separate category ('C').
quote: the MoC stemming from the general estimation error referred to in paragraph 43(b) is included in internal reporting in a separate category ('C')

obligation: The institution shall assess the level of the MoC as part of the regular reviews, in particular that the MoC for general estimation error remains appropriate after inclusion of the most recent data relevant for risk parameter estimation.
quote: the level of the MoC is assessed as part of the regular reviews referred to in Chapter 9 and in particular that the level of MoC related to the general estimation error remains appropriate
